title: Protected descendant settlement
responsibility: Stops proven private command processes under a deadline while leaving shared or uncertain processes untouched and recording the outcome.

inputs.name: haltProcesses.watch
inputs.description: Tracker whose alive method returns followed identities or null when unreadable.

inputs.name: haltProcesses.context
inputs.description: Command group, service authority and probes used to classify each process.

inputs.name: haltProcesses.limit
inputs.description: Grace duration and shared deadline for timeout termination.

inputs.name: settleProcesses.watch
inputs.description: Tracker of the ended command and descendants to settle.

inputs.name: settleProcesses.context
inputs.description: Classification context for private versus delegated/protected processes.

inputs.name: settleProcesses.timing
inputs.description: Optional settling/grace periods, default 2000/500 ms, and optional whole-cleanup bound; default bound adds 10000 ms slack.

outputs.name: haltProcesses
outputs.description: Resolves after bounded TERM then KILL attempts on freshly rechecked private processes only. Unreadable or expired observations cause no further signal.

outputs.name: settleProcesses
outputs.description: Settlement with counted survivors, stopped/resisted totals, unknown flag and log report. Vetted delegated services are handed over; protected/unproven processes remain and fail the check; errors or deadline exhaustion return unknown.
